Alice — great, 12/08 14:00 PST is booked. Calendar invite and conferencing link will follow. In advance of the call, answers to your bullets below (summary):

1) CMK & HSM: we support customer-managed keys for Hosted and Dedicated. The hosted path uses customer KMS integration with envelope encryption; Dedicated can be configured to use HSM-backed keys in customer VPCs (model depends on the deployment package). We’ll surface the HSM options (FIPS 140-2 level) on the call and map to your procurement controls.

2) Rotation & emergency procedures: default rotation cadence is 90 days; we support ad-hoc rotation with rolling re-encryption that preserves availability. Emergency rotation is supported — it triggers a short coordination window (typically under 30 minutes for token reissue) and we’ll walk through failback during the call.

3) Archival windows: retention tiers are configurable per-account. Typical presets: 30/90/365 days. Immutable snapshots (WORM-style) available as an add-on for Dedicated and Private deployments. Export timelines: standard export job completes within 24–48 hours for <1TB; expedited export available under SLA.

4) Log sampling: yes, we can provide a 7-day behavioral log window and anonymized traces. Format options: NDJSON or CSV. PII scrubbing: we produce redacted samples (hashing + tokenization) plus a scrubbed/raw mapping process for legal review under an NDA. For the CAIQ we typically provide: a sample manifest, one anonymized trace per requested tenant, and a sanitized audit log sample.

Pre-call asks:
- Please share the tenant IDs you want samples for and any specific time window (UTC).
- If procurement can circulate the DPA redlines ahead of time (we’ll have Kimberly review), that will speed the procurement path.

I’ve attached a short Q&A doc that addresses a few common follow-ups (quantumbridge_encryption_qna.docx) and re-attached the log sample instructions.

Thanks — talk Tuesday,

Ethan Park
Platform Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
